# Endorphic

> Endorphic is a healthcare communication agency based in Pune, India, helping doctors, clinics and hospitals communicate with clarity, credibility and impact. Endorphic is a 12-person team spanning content writing, web development, videography, editing, design and account management, founded by Pushkar Deshpande, a registered occupational therapist with an MBA and managerial experience across MNCs and hospitals.

Endorphic's permanent purpose is Enabling Better Healthcare. Communication is the company's current focus and starting point, not its ceiling - Endorphic intends to grow into a broader range of healthcare technology and services over time.

## Pages

- [Home](https://endorphic.in/): Overview of Endorphic's positioning, the communication problem healthcare organisations face, proof of outcomes, and the Endorphic communication model (Understand, Recommend, Create, Measure).
- [Solutions](https://endorphic.in/solutions.html): The six communication solutions Endorphic offers - Identity & Brand Communication, Patient Education & Engagement, Digital Presence & Visibility, Trust & Reputation Building, Communication Continuity, and Organisational Communication - plus the Healthcare Communication Starter package (₹7,999).
- [About](https://endorphic.in/about.html): Company background, leadership (Pushkar Deshpande, Founder & Director), the 12-person team structure, and Endorphic's mission and vision.
- [Contact](https://endorphic.in/contact.html): Ways to reach Endorphic - WhatsApp, email (hello@endorphic.in), phone (+91 94227 88557), and a contact form. Based in Pune, Maharashtra, India.
